title: Utah Teapot
description: Utah Teapot is a simple mod for testing that uses Polymesh to render the goat of 3D graphics.
body:
Utah Teapot is a simple mod that uses [Polymesh](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymesh) to render the goat of 3D graphics.

This mod isn't designed for gameplay. Its purpose is only to test [Polymesh](https://modrinth.com/mod/polymesh).


Get the official teapot model at [University of Utah - Utah Teapot](https://graphics.cs.utah.edu/teapot/)
